If the nightly export changes while the app is running, the two sources can also disagree on a customer's name or email, or on whether the customer exists. To go ahead, the owners need to: (a) accept that billing contacts for newly registered customers will change from NOT_FOUND to a real contact, which is probably the intended fix; (b) update the contract so billing.contact@1 depends on the customer store resource (for example, reads urn:example:customers:customer) instead of customers.lookup@1; and (c) add a verification method.
